nodes.label: AlbumViewModel
nodes.rationale: Uploads photos to Supabase Storage via AlbumRepository; resolves partner ID via PairingRepository to fetch shared album.

nodes.label: CelebrationConfig
nodes.rationale: Predefined celebratory dates (birthday, Christmas, Valentine's) — hardcoded because app targets a specific couple.

nodes.label: CelebrationOverlay
nodes.rationale: Fullscreen particle animation overlay; auto-dismisses after 4 seconds. Shown once per day via SharedPreferences date flag.

nodes.label: DoingPicker
nodes.rationale: Free-text activity input capped at 30 characters; references selected Feeling for contextual placeholder.

nodes.label: FeelingPicker
nodes.rationale: 3-column grid of Feeling entries; resolves emoji via EmojiThemeManager supporting theme-switchable emoji sets.

nodes.label: StatusCard
nodes.rationale: Gradient card displaying partner status — feeling drives gradient colors via Feeling.gradientStart/gradientEnd; breathing glow animation on shadow.

nodes.label: HistoryViewModel
nodes.rationale: Fetches merged timeline of own + partner statuses from Supabase; resolves partnerId via PairingRepository; limits to 20 entries each.

nodes.label: HomeViewModel
nodes.rationale: Polls Supabase every 6s via callbackFlow for real-time-like updates; caches partner ID in SharedPreferences; observes own + partner status from Room via flatMapLatest.

nodes.label: SettingsViewModel
nodes.rationale: Manages 6-char pairing code generation/join; emoji theme selection via EmojiThemeManager; caches paired state in SharedPreferences.

nodes.label: Device-UUID Identity
nodes.rationale: No user accounts — device UUID from SharedPreferences serves as userId. Two devices pair by exchanging a 6-character alphanumeric code. Rationale: couples app, no auth needed.

nodes.label: Polling-based Sync
nodes.rationale: No real-time subscriptions (WebSocket/SSE). Status updates use polling every 6 seconds via callbackFlow. Trade-off: simpler implementation vs slightly delayed updates.

hyperedges.label: MVVM+StateFlow Architecture Pattern
hyperedges.description: All four ViewModels follow identical pattern: @HiltViewModel with @Inject constructor receiving repositories/services; expose state via MutableStateFlow/StateFlow; run initialization in init{} block; use viewModelScope for coroutine launching.

hyperedges.label: Celebration Display Pipeline
hyperedges.description: CelebrationConfig defines static CelebrationDay instances. CelebrationOverlay renders fullscreen particle animation with spring scale and auto-dismiss after 4s. SettingsScreen embeds CelebrationOverlay when justPaired flag triggers after successful pairing.

hyperedges.label: Partner Identity Resolution Pattern
hyperedges.description: All three ViewModels resolve the partner's userId via the same pattern: call supabaseService.getCachedDeviceId() for self-ID, call pairingRepository.findPairByUserId(selfId), determine partnerId from pair.user1Id/user2Id. SettingsViewModel also uses this in checkExistingPair().
